os_list.name: APAX OS
os_list.description: Windows-style Pi 3 OS with the APAX brain. Flash this, boot, run the one-line installer.

items.name: APAX OS (Pi 3 / Pi Zero 2)
items.description: Base image = Raspberry Pi OS Lite (32-bit). After first boot: cd ~ && git clone https://github.com/Benkillingit/apax3.git && bash apax3/apax-os.sh — turns it into APAX OS (windows-style desktop, app translator, max video, APAX daemon).
